decision: confirmed signals are !Send and engine-thread-only, so workers hand over by channel
why: the plan already says workers never touch a signal; this makes it a compiler-enforced fact rather than a convention
evidence: nsh-core/src/element/reactive.rs thread_local graph; stored() = Signal<Rc<RefCell<T>>>
result: UiModel must use stored(), not RefCell across threads

decision: drafted memo.md with 18 plan corrections, keeping compiled and researched evidence apart

decision: proved chrome: Hidden bar, drag region, title_bar widths, and a working custom Close control

decision: replaced CopyFromScreen with PrintWindow PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT for app shots
why: GDI CopyFromScreen cannot read nsh's DirectComposition surface and returned stale pixels from a closed window, which would have produced false screenshots
evidence: shots/s3-chrome.png before and after the switch

decision: tray API runs and creates a notification-area icon, but close-to-hide is not default and on_click is unverified

decision: proved the bridge headless against the real 50k-store runtime: play, pause, resume, seek
why: window-click driving gave contradictory frozen frames, so the headless harness is the authoritative instrument
evidence: cargo test --test bridge: 1 passed in 4.31s, asserts playing then paused then playing and presses 1

decision: found the stored-borrow re-entrancy panic and fixed it by writing signals outside the borrow
why: writing a signal inside model.with notifies a binding that reads the same store and panics RefCell already borrowed; this is a hard N3 design constraint
evidence: nsh-core reactive.rs:552 panic before fix; test green after copying Copy signal handles out

decision: scanned the synthetic fixture end to end: 50000 files, 50000 indexed tracks
why: the fixture lever deferred scan verification to this step; this confirms the ID3-in-WAV mapping through the real pipeline
evidence: s7-scan.log SCAN COMPLETE total_files=50000 indexed_tracks=50000 elapsed_ms=546571

decision: proved 50k virtualization headless: 57 visible rows, jump to 40000, selection
why: the plan's core list risk; virtual_list keeps a bounded window and scroll_to_index restores position
evidence: cargo test --test list green; screen count id:row-index = 57

decision: named the scroll limiter: scattered track_row costs ~10ms/call vs 119us sequential
why: 20 headless scroll steps took 61712ms (3086ms/step); without a named limiter that number is untrustworthy, so I timed the projection directly
evidence: tests/projection_cost.rs: sequential 119.5us, scattered 9990.6us, same-index 225.2us, track_count 6552us
result: plan correction: N6 needs the prefetch window, direct per-row reads are too slow
